subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should this issue wait for a live current-main Docker reproduction before queueing another fix PR, or should a maintainer adopt a related cron/heartbeat PR as the fix path?
rationale: Current source and tests cover the intended per-agent route, but the reporter has newer installed-release evidence that the route still fails; automation cannot safely choose a code change until the failing entry path is identified.

options.title: Require live scheduled-heartbeat repro
options.body: Reproduce the reporter's Docker config on current main with distinct HEARTBEAT.md files and isolatedSession true/false before opening another fix PR.

options.title: Split manual system-event subset
options.body: Treat untargeted openclaw system event behavior as adjacent to the open cron/heartbeat wake PRs, while keeping this issue for scheduled secondary-agent heartbeat routing.

options.title: Fold into broad heartbeat contamination tracker
options.body: If maintainers decide this is not a distinct routing bug, link it under the broader heartbeat contamination issue and preserve the reporter's Docker evidence there.

recommendation.title: Require live scheduled-heartbeat repro
recommendation.body: Reproduce the reporter's Docker config on current main with distinct HEARTBEAT.md files and isolatedSession true/false before opening another fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent current-main signal across the heartbeat runner, gateway cron resolver, and previous stale-runtime fix provenance.
